top_signals.title: Venezuela’s Oil Revival Accelerates as Foreign Companies Return
top_signals.summary: Hundreds of oil executives have flocked to Venezuela’s capital city of Caracas this week for the first major industry event in the country in decades. The Venezuela International Oil & Gas Summit is taking place nine months after the U.S. captured Nicolas Maduro, installed a U.S.-friendly administration, and vowed to open Venezuela’s oil reserves – the world’s biggest – to development by international companies.
